audit.whatIsWrong: The chart handed Levels 3 through first item to Cassiopeia and graded the lane TRICKY at 7.5/10, while the page's own whys give Aurora every one of those stages and the win rate is 59.65%.
audit.why: whys[1] to whys[5] read "you double-hit and trade up", "your double-hit poke out-damages her ramping poison", "you control every trade", "Petrifying Gaze whiffs", "your last clean kill window" — an Aurora lane on six of seven rows, with only two items going to Cassiopeia. 59.65% over 57 games is the highest win rate in this slice; grading it TRICKY with an orange tone is the single most misleading thing on the page.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Aurora / Aurora / Aurora / Aurora / Aurora / Aurora / Cassiopeia, and the grade moved from TRICKY 7.5/10 to FAV 4/10 with the matching tone.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 phase named Aurora's ultimate "Between the Worlds" — no such ability — and never gave Petrifying Gaze's cooldown or its facing rule, so the 6 spike was described as a whiff rather than a choice.
audit.why: Petrifying Gaze is 120/100/80 at 825 range and Between Worlds is 140/120/100, so Cassiopeia gets her ultimate back 20 seconds sooner at rank 1. More importantly Riot's text says it stuns "any enemies in front of her that are facing her" and only slows "any others with their back turned" — turning away downgrades the stun to a slow, which is the actual level-6 counterplay and appears nowhere on the page.
audit.corrected: Between Worlds is 140s; Petrifying Gaze is 120s and stuns only enemies facing her — turn your back as she casts and you take a slow.

audit.whatIsWrong: The grounding line says Miasma disables "dashes and movement abilities" in the abstract without naming which of Aurora's spells it kills, and Twin Fang's healing is never mentioned. spikes[1] also claims Between Worlds makes Aurora untargetable to Cassiopeia, which Riot's description does not say.
audit.why: Miasma (W, 24/22/20/18/16, 700): "Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities." Aurora's Across the Veil (W) and Between Worlds (R) are both leaps, so a single Miasma cloud takes away both of her escapes at once — that is the whole matchup, and 24 seconds at rank 1 is the longest punishable cooldown either champion has in lane. Twin Fang (E, 0.75s, 700) "deals increased damage to Poisoned targets and heals her for a percentage of the damage dealt", so fighting while Noxious Blast poison ticks on you is what feeds her sustain. Noxious Blast (Q) is only 3.5s and grants her Move Speed on a champion hit, amplified by Serpentine Grace (P) — chasing her after a Q hit does not work.
audit.corrected: Miasma grounds you: inside it both Across the Veil and Between Worlds are disabled, so wait out its 24 seconds before you step up.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags this matchup as having no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere — no line said wait for X before you do Y.
audit.why: Miasma at 24s versus Across the Veil at 22s is the sequencing that decides the lane: if you spend your leap first she can ground you before it is back, and if she spends Miasma first you have a 24-second window where your leap cannot be taken away.
audit.corrected: Miasma is 24s at rank 1 — wait for it to expire before you spend Across the Veil, or you land inside the grounding.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal note anywhere, and the late-game line only says "shift to picks".
audit.why: Twin Fang heals Cassiopeia for a percentage of its damage every 0.75 seconds against a poisoned target. Grievous Wounds timing is what decides an extended trade against her, exactly as _missing/aurora.json flags.
audit.corrected: Twin Fang heals her off poisoned targets — never fight while Noxious Blast ticks.

notes: The calibration example in my brief was drawn from this champion pair and the fabricated names it warned about are not present here: the page correctly uses Noxious Blast for Q and correctly attributes grounding to Miasma (W). spikes[1] still claims Between Worlds "drops you untargetable to her", which Riot's description of the ability does not support — I did not repeat it and logged it in unverified.
